test_locate_round_trip: test that locate resolves a string path back to the original Python object
test_convert_target_to_string: test that _convert_target_to_string converts a Python object to its fully qualified import path
test_locate_builtin: test that locate correctly resolves built-in functions like len and dict
test_locate_pytorch: test that locate resolves PyTorch objects like torch.optim.SGD that pydoc.locate cannot
test_locate_failure: test that locate raises an ImportError when given an invalid string path
